title: Mail Template Test Sender Permission Consistency

items.action: render and send a mail-template test message
load and choose an explicit email account for a test message

migration.reason: Both consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing mail-template execution authorization and default-email-account resolution remain unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No API contract changes are introduced; the existing test-send contract already accepts email_account_id=null to use the organization default active account.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend resource lookup, query, or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: Existing mail-send audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: Mail Templates navigation and its existing route permission remain unchanged.

route_guard.reason: The existing Mail Templates route guard is unchanged.

notes: Mail Templates execute permission continues to authorize render and test-send actions. Email account read permission is only required to enumerate and explicitly choose sender accounts. When a user can execute mail templates but cannot read email accounts, the frontend does not call the email-account list endpoint, does not expose the account picker, and sends email_account_id=null so the existing backend contract resolves the organization's default active account. Users with email_accounts.read retain the explicit account-picker path. Backend permission and API semantics are unchanged.
